function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieves a list of all API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose API tokens are to be retrieved.

active_only.description: A flag to determine if only active tokens should be returned.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Create a new API token which can be used to authenticate against the API endpoints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The username associated with the account for which the API token is being created.

password.description: The password corresponding to the username for authentication.

token_name.description: A human-readable name for the API token.

expires_in.description: The number of days until the API token expires. If not provided, the token will not expire.

permissions.description: The level of access the API token will grant, expressed as a role name.
